description: MoroJS 1.8 on its native HTTP engine (@morojs/engine), default configuration, clustered by the framework itself with one worker thread per core sharing the port through SO_REUSEPORT. Routing, path and query parameters and body parsing through the Moro request, JSON through res.json, compression, static files and the cache-aside through the built-in middleware and cache adapters, WebSockets through the engine's own RFC 6455 support, HTTP/2 through Moro's HTTP/2 server on Node's http2 module.
